desc:
🎃 HALLOWEEN! Witch's Case, Candy Coins & 3x coins until Wednesday!

Welcome to Custom Duels, a pad-based sword fighting game.

⚔️ Sword fight other players!
🪙 Earn coins!
✨ Open cases and unlock special effects!
🏆 Challenge other players in daily tournaments and events!
🔊 Voice chat and socialize with other players!

⚠️ Make sure to read our rules closely and follow them at all times. Failure to do so can result in a data reset or permanent ban from the game.
